children: Solv Protocol is set to unlock 159.32 million SOLV in January 2027. The tokens represent 2.70% of the circulating supply and are allocated to investors, the team, and ecosystem wallets.
The release adds to the amount of SOLV that could be offered for sale. Once the tokens are unlocked, investors and team members can sell SOLV from allocations that were previously locked.

title: Solv Protocol: 159.32 Million SOLV Unlocks - Jan 2027
